uncited: *   Classify pixels into $C$ semantic groups based on caption embeddings $E(c)$.
*   Map projected pixels to semantic masks to assign expected shapes online.
*   **Strengths:** Effective for large-scale scenes; reduces over-reconstruction in low-frequency areas and under-reconstruction in high-frequency areas.
*   **Limitations:** Relies on the accuracy of GroundingSAM and Canny Edge detection; requires modification of the rasterization kernel.
It addresses the issue of uniform Gaussian distribution by adapting shapes to local geometric complexity.
